What is a Hadith (ثیدح)? - A report of the sayings, actions, or approvals of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What are the two main components of a Hadith (ثیدح)? - Sanad (دنس) - chain of narrators, and Matn (نتم) - text of the Hadith.
What is Hadith Qudsi (ثیدح یسدق)? - A Hadith in which Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) conveys words from Allah but not as part of the Quran.
What is Hadith e Qauli (ثیدح یلوق)? - A Hadith that contains the spoken words or sayings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is Hadith e Fili (ثیدح یلعف)? - A Hadith that describes the actions or practices of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is Hadith Nabawi (یوبن ثیدح)? - A Hadith that includes the sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Sahih Hadith (ثیدح حیحص)? - A Hadith that is authentic, having a strong chain of narrators with no defects.
What is a Da'if Hadith (ثیدح فیعض)? - A weak Hadith due to a missing or unreliable narrator.
What is a Hasan Hadith (ثیدح نسح)? - A Hadith that is slightly weaker than Sahih but still acceptable.
What is a Mawdu Hadith (ثیدح عوضوم)? - A fabricated Hadith falsely attributed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Mutawatir Hadith (ثیدح رتاوتم)? - A Hadith reported by a large number of narrators in every generation, making fabrication impossible.
What is an Ahad Hadith (ثیدح داحآ)? - A Hadith reported by a limited number of narrators and not reaching the level of Mutawatir.
What are the three types of Ahad Hadith (ثیدح داحآ)? - Gharib (بیرغ), Aziz (زیزع), Mashhur (روہشم).
What is a Gharib Hadith (ثیدح بیرغ)? - A Hadith narrated by a single person at some stage of its chain.
What is an Aziz Hadith (ثیدح زیزع)? - A Hadith narrated by at least two narrators at all levels of the chain.
What is a Mashhur Hadith (ثیدح روہشم)? - A Hadith initially narrated by a few people but later widely reported.
What is a Taqreeri Hadith (یریرقت ثیدح)? - A Hadith where someone spoke or acted in front of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), and he remained silent, indicating approval.
What is a Hadith Ijmali (یلامجا ثیدح)? - A Hadith that is narrated by all four Imams (Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Malik, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad).
What is a Hadith Ahle Madina (ہنیدم لہا ثیدح)? - A Hadith narrated primarily by the people of Madina based on their practices.
What is a Hadith Ahle Makkah (ہکم لہا ثیدح)? - A Hadith narrated primarily by the people of Makkah based on their traditions.
What is a Marfu Hadith (عوفرم ثیدح)? - A Hadith directly attributed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Mauquf Hadith (فوقوم ثیدح)? - A Hadith that stops at a Companion (Sahabi) and is not directly attributed to the Prophet (PBUH).
What is a Maqtu Hadith (عوطقم ثیدح)? - A Hadith that stops at a Tabi'i (یعبات) (Successor of a Companion).
What is a Musnad Hadith (دنسم ثیدح)? - A Hadith with a continuous chain reaching Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Mursal Hadith (لسرم ثیدح)? - A Hadith where a Tabi'i (یعبات) directly attributes a statement to the Prophet (PBUH), skipping the Companion.
What is a Mudallas Hadith (سلدم ثیدح)? - A Hadith where a narrator hides or skips a weak narrator in the chain to make it appear authentic.
What is Ijma 1 (عامجا)? - Consensus of Islamic scholars on a religious ruling after the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It is considered a source of Islamic law.
What is Ijtihad 2 (داہتجا)? - Independent reasoning by a qualified scholar to derive Islamic rulings when there is no clear text in Quran or Hadith.
What is Qiyas 3 (سایق)? - Analogical reasoning where a ruling is derived for a new issue by comparing it with an existing ruling in Quran, Hadith, or Ijma.

What is Hadith in Islamic scholarship? - A report transmitting the sayings, actions, tacit approvals, or descriptions attributed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
How are Hadith and Sunnah related? - Hadith are transmitted reports; Sunnah is the Prophetic way or normative practice conveyed through such reports and practice.
What are the two principal parts of a Hadith report? - Isnad (chain of transmission) and Matn (text/content).
What is Isnad? - The chain of transmitters through whom a Hadith is reported.
What is Matn? - The actual text or content of a Hadith report.
What is Hadith Qauli? - A report conveying a saying of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is Hadith Fi'li? - A report describing an action or practice of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is Hadith Taqriri? - A report of an act or statement done in the Prophet's presence which he tacitly approved.
What is Hadith Qudsi? - A Hadith in which Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) reports a message from Allah that is not part of the Quran.
What is a Sahih Hadith? - A sound Hadith meeting the classical conditions of connected transmission, reliable and accurate narrators, and freedom from serious contradiction and hidden defect.
What is a Hasan Hadith? - An acceptable Hadith whose transmitters are reliable but whose precision is generally below the level required for Sahih.
What is a Da'if Hadith? - A weak Hadith that fails one or more conditions required for Sahih or Hasan classification.
What is a Mawdu' Hadith? - A fabricated report falsely attributed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
What is a Mutawatir Hadith? - A report transmitted through such numerous independent narrators at every level that deliberate collusion on a false report is conventionally considered impossible.
What is an Ahad Hadith? - A Hadith that does not reach the level of Mutawatir transmission.
What is a Gharib Hadith? - A Hadith with only one narrator at some stage of its chain of transmission.
What is an Aziz Hadith? - An Ahad Hadith transmitted by at least two narrators at the relevant levels of its chain.
What is a Mashhur Hadith in Hadith terminology? - An Ahad Hadith transmitted by three or more narrators at the relevant levels but not reaching Mutawatir level.
What is a Marfu' report? - A report attributed to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), whether a saying, action, approval, or description.
What is a Mawquf report? - A report attributed to, or stopping at, a Companion rather than the Prophet (PBUH).
What is a Maqtu' report? - A report attributed to, or stopping at, a Tabi'i (Successor).
What is a Mursal Hadith? - A report in which a Tabi'i attributes a statement directly to the Prophet (PBUH), omitting the Companion in the chain.
What is a Musnad Hadith? - In common Hadith terminology, a Marfu' report with a connected chain reaching the Prophet (PBUH).
What is Tadlis in Hadith transmission? - A narrator reports in an ambiguous way that conceals a defect or an intermediary in the chain; a report containing it may be called Mudallas.
What is Asma al-Rijal? - The biographical study of Hadith transmitters used to identify narrators and assess their reliability and transmission history.
What is Jarh wa Ta'dil? - The discipline of criticising and accrediting Hadith narrators to assess their reliability.
What does Al-Kutub al-Sittah mean? - The six canonical Sunni Hadith collections; it does not mean that all six books are titled Sahih.
Which books are commonly called Al-Kutub al-Sittah? - Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami' at-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, and Sunan Ibn Majah.
